summary: Live Donation Feed + CSRF regression verified end-to-end for Caring Sisters Club admin. All four test cases PASSED. Session cookie 'qa-livefeed-tok' auth worked. Inserted a paid donation directly into MongoDB payment_transactions, triggered admin UI auto-refresh (and manual refresh), and confirmed the new row rendered with gold highlight, Sparkles icon, correct testid, and a toast. CSRF-protected admin PUT /admin/settings (Campaign save) and donor notes save both succeeded with the X-Requested-With header set by the axios instance.

test_results.case: Live Donation Feed - new row highlight + toast
test_results.evidence: After inserting qa_livefeed donation and refreshing, element with data-testid='donation-row-new' exists, has class 'gift-row-new', contains a Sparkles SVG, and the text 'LiveFeed Tester ... $500 ... One-Time' appears. Toast captured: '🎉 A new gift just arrived! LiveFeed Tester gave $500.' Totals updated $300->$800 and 2->3 Gifts. Auto-refresh (20s) path also observed on first run (toast fired without manual refresh).
Changed Large-Gift Threshold to 275, clicked Save Campaign, toast 'Campaign updated - Your donor wall now reflects the changes.' displayed. Reverted to 250 successfully.
Opened first donor, filled a note, clicked data-testid='save-notes-btn', toast 'Saved - Donor notes and tags updated.' displayed.

test_results.case: Regression - Manual Refresh + Last Updated timestamp
test_results.evidence: data-testid='refresh-donations-btn' present and clickable; data-testid='donations-last-updated' shows e.g. 'Updated 9:03 AM'.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDonations.jsx: knownIds baseline is reset to null whenever the filter changes, which is correct, but if the admin switches filter at the exact moment a new gift arrives, that gift will be swallowed silently (no toast/highlight). Low-priority edge case.

AdminDonations.jsx line 83: newIds auto-clears after 6s via setTimeout, which could race with another refresh that queues more newIds. Current state replacement with setNewIds(fresh.map(...)) means a 2nd batch during the 6s window will overwrite the first. Minor.
seed_data_creation: Inserted + deleted one payment_transactions doc with source='qa_livefeed'. The 2 real donations preserved. Verified cleanup: deleted 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The newIds highlight auto-clears after 6s. If verifying via auto-refresh (20s), check for the toast rather than the testid, OR trigger via manual refresh and check within 5s. The toast fires in the same branch that applies the testid/class/sparkles.
